map.抗压强度/抗渗等级/环保达标: Compressive strength / impermeability grade / environmental compliance
map.本工具用于检测（抗压/抗渗/环保）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates (compressive/impermeable/environmental) testing inputs against format and syntax rules in real time, locating errors; pure front-end, no upload.
map.📚 深度解析：混凝土进场三项检测判定（抗压/抗渗/环保）: 📚 Deep Dive: Concrete Incoming Three-Item Test (Compressive/Impermeable/Environmental)
map.材料自检：按抗压强度、抗渗等级、环保达标率三项判定: Material self-check: judge by compressive strength, impermeability grade and environmental rate
map.结构安全：抗压强度是承载力根本: Structural safety: compressive strength is the basis of load capacity
map.报告可用性：三项全合格方可用于结构验收: Report usability: only all three pass may it be used for structural acceptance
map.逐项判定：抗压强度≥30MPa、抗渗等级≥8 级、环保达标率≥90%；三项均满足: Item-by-item: compressive ≥30 MPa, impermeability ≥ grade 8, environmental ≥90%; all pass → qualified. Compressive maps to design grade (e.g. C30), impermeability to grade (e.g. P8).
map.抗压 35MPa（≥30 ✓）、抗渗 8 级（≥8 ✓）、环保 94%（≥90: Compressive 35 MPa (≥30 ✓), impermeability grade 8 (≥8 ✓), environmental 94% (≥90 ✓): all pass → qualified. If compressive drops to 25 MPa it fails, below the C30 design — reject.
map.抗渗等级和抗压强度有关系吗？: Is impermeability related to compressive strength?
map.二者相关但不等价：高强混凝土通常更致密、抗渗更好，但仍须分别检测；抗渗不足会渗漏: They correlate but are not equivalent: high-strength concrete is usually denser and more impermeable, yet both must be tested; poor impermeability leaks and rusts rebar, hurting durability.
map.三项合格就能浇筑？: Can you pour once all three pass?
map.仅代表材料进场自检合格；实际浇筑还须配合比、坍落度、试块留置与同条件养护强度，以: It only means material incoming self-check passed; actual pouring also needs mix ratio, slump, specimen retention and same-condition curing strength per the field report.
map.抗压强度测试需按规定养护28天后进行: Compressive testing needs 28 days of prescribed curing
map.混凝土抗渗检测需制作标准试件，湿养护后试验: Concrete impermeability needs standard specimens, tested after moist curing
